outcome: Participants' reports on the intervention's impact on predictors of breastfeeding success
cohort: Prenatal patients and their supporters from an urban community medical center who either participated in or did not participate in a live, online prenatal education class between June 2020 and April 2022.
finding: Participants in the live, online prenatal education intervention were significantly more likely (2.12 times) to exclusively breastfeed at hospital discharge compared to non-participants.
